name: Marketing
intro: Marketers who plan, create and run your campaigns, and keep your channels bringing in leads.

roleDetails.text: Keeps campaigns on schedule, coordinates content and launches, and handles the day-to-day marketing tasks.
Plans and writes blog posts, emails, web copy and other content that brings in and educates buyers.
Researches keywords, improves your site's pages and technical setup, and tracks how you rank in search.
Plans and posts content across your social channels, engages with followers and reports on what's working.
Builds and manages ad campaigns on Google, Meta and LinkedIn, and tunes them for cost and results.
Builds the emails and automated sequences that welcome, nurture and win back customers.
Runs your marketing tools and CRM, sets up automations and keeps lead data and reporting clean.
